title: Prospective matched comparison: affine sharp bounds versus CRABS finite clouds
question: When the pulled signal, turnover cap, grid, interpolation rule and floating-point tolerances are held fixed, how closely and how efficiently do finite CRABS clouds recover the sharp pointwise speciation-rate endpoints?

scope.conditioning: fixed pulled signal only; this is a deterministic method comparison, not statistical coverage

common_numerical_conventions.pulled_scale: cumulative trapezoidal integration of the common piecewise-linear lambda_p signal
common_numerical_conventions.CRABS_reference: lambda_ref=lambda_p, mu_ref=0; create.model computes p.delta using CRABS' forward/backward pracma::fderiv convention

estimands.CRABS_discrete_endpoints: recursive sharp endpoints under CRABS' backward-difference p.delta equation, obtained by setting epsilon_i=0 and epsilon_i=c at every step
estimands.finite_cloud_endpoints: pointwise minimum and maximum lambda among accepted sampled histories
estimands.primary_endpoint: upper speciation endpoint at tau=70 Ma
estimands.secondary_endpoints: both endpoints at every non-zero-width released knot

proposals.mechanism: draw epsilon_i independently Uniform(0,c), solve CRABS' discrete congruence quadratic recursively for lambda_i, set mu_i=epsilon_i*lambda_i, and instantiate a CRABS joint congruent model for implementation checks

proposals.role: out-of-box CRABS proposal under the matched cap
proposals.mechanism: CRABS::sample.basic.models.joint with HSMRF defaults beta.param=c(0.3,0.3), mrf.sd.scale=1, min.p=0, max.p=1; draw mu0 Uniform(0,c*lambda0); reject any trajectory whose knotwise mu/lambda exceeds c

metrics: pointwise lower and upper endpoint deficits, normalised by exact CRABS-discrete identified width
fraction of non-zero-width knots recovered within 1%, 5% and 10% of width
exact affine endpoint runtime over 1000 repetitions

decision_rules.material_endpoint_miss: At N=10000, a proposal materially misses if its cloud remains more than 5% of the CRABS-discrete identified width from either endpoint at any non-zero-width knot in at least 5 of 10 replicates.
decision_rules.native_practical_failure: The native HSMRF route fails practicality if any replicate cannot produce 10000 accepted histories within 500000 proposals, or if its median acceptance rate is below 2%.
decision_rules.adoption_conclusion: Recommend the affine routine for endpoint certification if either material_endpoint_miss or native_practical_failure occurs. Recommend CRABS for exploration where a finite cloud, rather than a certificate, is the target. If neither occurs, report that CRABS empirically approximates these endpoints at the preregistered scale but still does not certify them.
decision_rules.discretisation_warning: No method-comparison claim will use a continuous-affine versus sampled-CRABS difference without separately reporting the CRABS-discrete endpoint; this prevents finite-difference error being mislabelled as sampling error.

failure_and_missingness_policy.proposal_ceiling_hit: record as censored/practical failure; do not replace the seed
failure_and_missingness_policy.nonfinite_or_invalid_history: count as rejected and report reason
failure_and_missingness_policy.package_install_or_runtime_failure: emit a machine-readable stop receipt with logs; do not substitute an unlabelled reimplementation
failure_and_missingness_policy.post_hoc_tuning: forbidden in the primary analysis; any rescue run must be labelled exploratory
